text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So everyone, did all our feelings get
across to
you?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
We heard your voices too. We heard you

cheering us on.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Why of course. If not for that, there
would be
little meaning in us having this
concert at all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
We'll never forget what we shared here
today, or
your kind words of support.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: We will always run alongside you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thunderous applause and cheers fill the
arena.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together with their fans, the girls sing
song after
song...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...Songs from the heart.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I... I can't believe it. You can hear the
cheers all
the way from here.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Trainer. For sticking
with me
through thick and thin.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
For giving me the opportunity to build
this... this
beautiful concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzz, bzz!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry! Who's texting right in the
middle of...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: "Thank you."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: It's from her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Concert brings Umamusume
and their
fans together in one
impassioned dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But as with any dream, the morning
comes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text: Well, that's all for today's lesson!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, uh, Falcon. If you're free, wanna go
over the
choreography from earlier
together?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The choreography from earlier? You
mean...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: You know... for the backup dancers.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...I'm good. If we're pretending it's the
real thing,
then I definitely shouldn't be
smiling. I mean, this
choreo is for backup
dancers.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I dunno about you, but I don't want to
get too
used to this dance. If I can get
through it with a
smile, it means I'll never
reach center stage.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ever since performing in the Grand
Concert, I
can't get the fans' smiles out
of my head.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
So I've made up my mind—I want to
dance with a
smile no matter where I am
on stage.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Because, well... I realized I get more
motivated
that way. Like, "Next time, I
want to win for
them," you know?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Okay then, let's do this! But get
ready,
'cause I don't accept half-hearted
smiles!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hello, everyone. It's been a while.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hello! How's planning for next year's
Grand
Concert going?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Swimmingly, thanks to cooperation from
the folks
at URA. Actually, I came here
to talk to you all
about that.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So, for our next publicity poster, I was
thinking of
using this group photo...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Group photo?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh! From the Grand Concert!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...It's wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
It truly is. The person who took it, she
said to me
with a smile...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"This shot lit a fire in me. It made me
want to
shine just as bright as they do..."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...And it made me want to cheer for
them with all
my heart."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I want to light that same fire in all the
new runners
soon to debut, and all the
people soon to
become new fans.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Would you let me pass her emotions on
with this
photo?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello's plea is answered across the
board
with nods—and smiles.
